nodes.name: 门石透红
nodes.light: deep red light glowing out through the pale stone of the gate onto her hands and face, cold blue pre-dawn snow light everywhere else, a thin violet glow far up the ridge
nodes.camera: low on the snow step beside her, close on her two hands on the stone, the six higher gates climbing away above, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last dark hour before dawn, high on a snow mountain. A stair of snow-covered stone climbs the ridge past seven colossal gates of pale stone, one above another, each a single slab of rock sealed shut, the upper ones fading into cloud; a thin violet glow veins the highest of them. Only the lowest gate is near: a wall of pale stone wider than a house, carved all over with worn overlapping dragon scales, like the hide of a great reptile; there is no balance, no weighing pans and no emblem of any kind on it. From inside the stone a deep red light is glowing through, as if the rock were a hand held over a lamp. In front of the gate, in full profile facing right, stands the white-haired dragonborn gate-girl, eighteen but looking sixteen: snow-white hair cut to the jaw with one thin braid falling on her chest, ice-blue eyes with narrow slit pupils, fine pale scales along the side of her neck, a long white felt robe with a high collar, its sleeves tied tight at the wrists with red cord. Both her arms are stretched out in front of her and both palms are pressed flat on the gate; the red light comes through between her fingers and turns the frost on her cuffs and on her eyelashes bright red. Her feet are planted, her back is very straight, and her lips are parted in the middle of a recitation. Behind her on the steps, small, an old woman wrapped in furs leans on a staff and watches her, and far down the stair a few early fires burn where families are climbing. Across a deep valley on the left, far off, a flat stone terrace on another ridge shows a single small light. Wind-driven snow crystals drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一拍（源稿第159行）：维嘉每天天亮以前去最低那一道门前，两只手按上去，门石里的红光透过指缝，把袖口的霜照得通红；祖母说门两万年没热过，她没有松手。最高那一道门的紫脉先亮照第162行。隔谷那一点光是霜眠祭台。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿把门上的“鳞”画成了一架天平的浮雕，写明是龙鳞重画。

nodes.name: 头巾缠腕
who: the tall woman with the deep-blue headscarf
nodes.light: seven colours of gate light from across the valley falling on the two of them, low orange campfires behind, a white flash of lightning fading on the far ridge, black sky
nodes.camera: low among the kneeling people on the terrace, close on the scarf and the two wrists, the ladder of lit gates filling the sky between the two figures, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midnight on a flat stone terrace high on a snow ridge. A dozen campfires burn low, and forty-odd travellers in furs are down on their knees in the snow with their heads bowed. Across a deep valley the opposite mountain carries a ladder of light: seven colossal stone gates, one above another up the ridge, all blazing, each in a different colour, and out of each gate a skeleton as tall as a cliff has stepped, bones as pale as the gate stone, one colour of light burning between its ribs, none of them with a face. Six are climbing; the seventh, violet, stands on top of the highest gate and looks back down. A white scar of fresh lightning has just split the snow stair between the gates into a sheer cliff, tiny torches stranded above it and below it. In the foreground two people are on their feet, facing each other. On the right, in full profile facing left, the tall woman with the deep-blue headscarf has just unwound it: long silver-white hair loose to the waist, the last hand's length of it shining in seven colours at once, pale gold eyes, and above each temple one slim smooth crystalline horn, bare now: her head is completely uncovered, nothing on it at all, because the only scarf she owns is the one now in her hands; she wears an old pale camel travelling coat. With both hands she is winding the deep-blue scarf round the wrist the man holds out to her: her right hand draws the end tight, her left hand presses the knot. On the left, in full profile facing right, the white-haired dragonborn guide, tall and lean, snow-white hair cropped very short, pale scales on the back of his neck, a thick felt guide's coat with the collar up, holds out his left arm to her, wrist upward, his right hand clenched at his side; his eyes are on the far gates, not on her. Sparks from the fires and blown snow drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第六拍（源稿第171行）：霜眠祭台上她的发梢七色都亮了，她解下头巾，露出额角两截细角，把头巾缠在尤恩腕上，说攥着它血就不往下伏。远处七道门一齐亮、每道门里走出一具骸影、紫的那一具停在门顶上回头照第168、169行，雪阶劈成断崖照第170行。骸影没有脸。阿蕾缇娅用人形立绘。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿她头上还包着头巾、手里又多一条，写明头上空着重画。

nodes.name: 第七道
nodes.light: the first red-gold ray of sunrise striking the dragon's back from the right and running down the snow stair as a line of red sun-lightning, black thunder-dark piled overhead being torn open along that line
nodes.camera: low on the snow stair below the stele field, looking up past the dragon's spread wings at the thing coming down, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last minute before sunrise high on a snow mountain, where a broad stair of snow-covered stone climbs through seven great stone gates, one above another, each gate glowing a different colour. Below the lowest gate stands a field of tall inscribed stone slabs, and among them hundreds of small people in furs kneel in family groups, chanting. In the middle of the picture a dragon stands with her wings spread wide in front of the slabs, seen from behind and below: a slender silver-white dragon with two crystalline horns, as in the last attached picture. Across the membranes of her wings seven bands of colour burn side by side, red, orange, yellow, green, blue-green, blue and violet-white, the seventh just lit. Coming down the stair toward her from the top gate is a towering shape of piled lightning in the outline of a huge crowned dragon skeleton, with no face, light pouring into it from six smaller skeletal dragon shades that kneel beaten on the steps, each a different colour. Its bolt has just fallen on her and she has not moved. At this instant the first ray of the sun touches her back, and from her a single line of red-gold lightning runs straight up the stair through all seven gates, splitting the black sky above the top gate so that a red seam opens in it. Small at the lowest gate, a white-haired dragonborn girl presses both palms on the stone, unhurt, her mouth open in a shout. Snow turned to rain and red sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第145行那一条）：她张开翼挡在碑林前头，翼膜上六道颜色，僭雷的雷落下来，她没有躲，第七道亮了；头一线日光落到她背上，血里的赤红阳雷顺着雪阶往下贯，一道光从最高那道门穿到最低那道门，压黑的那一片天从当中掀开。阿蕾缇娅这一仗是龙形，拿真龙原形那一张当设计参考。僭雷写成没有脸的雷和骨。维嘉十八岁，远处小人，不受伤。

nodes.name: 鳞钥
who: the tall woman with silver-white hair
nodes.light: a high bright morning sun on fresh snow, hard white-gold light, blue shadows, seven small coloured glints in the girl's cupped hands
nodes.camera: from two steps below the girl, looking up past her cupped hands at the tall woman, the standing stones and the bright sky above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bright morning with the sun already high, at the top of a snow stair on a great mountain, under a forest of tall standing stones. Down the ridge behind, seven colossal stone gates stand dark again, plain sealed rock, and the snow between them is trampled and scorched in long streaks. On the right, facing us, stands the tall woman with silver-white hair: hair loose to the waist with its last hand's length a soft red in the sun, pale gold eyes, one slim smooth crystalline horn above each temple, no scarf on her head, an old pale camel travelling coat. Her right hand is half raised with the palm open and has stopped short of taking what is offered; her left hand hangs at her side. In front of her, in full profile facing right, the white-haired dragonborn gate-girl, eighteen, snow-white hair cut to the jaw with one thin braid, a long white felt robe, holds both cupped hands up at the height of her chest, and in them lie seven small rough stones, each faintly glowing a different colour. One step behind the girl, also in full profile facing right, the white-haired dragonborn guide, tall and lean, a deep-blue scarf wound round his left wrist, rests his right hand on her shoulder. Down the stair behind them hundreds of people in furs who have knelt in the snow all night are getting to their feet, family by family, brushing the snow from their knees; a few still kneel. High above, inside a bank of thundercloud, the dim outlines of several enormous long shapes hang still. Sunlit snow crystals drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一到三拍（源稿第187到189行）：维嘉把七块石头捡齐，跟哥哥爬上雪阶，把石头捧上去；她停了很久才接；跪了一夜的人起来。雷云里那几道影子照第189行，不画脸。头巾在尤恩腕上照第192行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十一层
nodes.name: 担保印
nodes.light: clear early morning light from the open door on the left, warm on the desk and the white slip, the hall behind in brown shadow
nodes.camera: at desk height, close on the seal and the clerk's two hands, the guild master leaning in from the left, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early morning at the door desk of a great guild commission hall of stone and timber; notice boards crowded with slips line the walls, and beside the door hangs a board with rows of small brass travel seals nailed to it. On the desk lies one white-edged slip covered with fine unreadable lines. On the right, seated behind the desk in full profile facing left, is the lilac-haired apprentice clerk, nineteen, small, with a pointed chin, pale lilac hair in one braid coiled tight at the back of her head: her right hand has just pressed a small round seal down on the slip and still holds it there, her left hand grips her own right wrist to stop it shaking, and the mark under the seal sits perfectly straight. Her eyes are wide. On the left, standing in full profile facing right, the red-haired tiefling guild master leans a little forward to look at the mark: tall, dark red hair tied back in one tail, two swept-back horns, a plain grey travelling cloak, a long sword at his hip, a pack on his back with a loaf of black rye bread sticking out of its flap; his right hand rests flat on the edge of the desk, his left thumb is hooked in his pack strap, and he is half smiling. Behind him in the open doorway, facing us, stands the bear-eared rope-keeper, a tall big-boned woman with honey-coloured hair in one thick braid and two round bear ears, a coil of rope over her shoulder, both arms folded across her chest, frowning at his back. Deep in the hall, small, a huge copper-scaled dragonborn cook in an apron carries a steaming pot past. Dust motes in the door light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第六、七拍（源稿第427、428行）：伯娜在门口拦他；凡妮莎按担保印的时候手一直在抖，印落下去是正的，他看了一眼说按正了；翁贝托往他包里塞了十四个黑麦面包。单子写成认不出的细行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十一层
nodes.name: 麦地如毯
nodes.light: a flat grey sky that never brightens, a dull brass-coloured glow on the far horizon, cold even light with no sun, flying earth dark against it
nodes.camera: low in the wheat behind the guild master's boots, looking up along the line of boundary stones at the colossus as its arm comes down, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a grey day that never brightens, on a deep floor of the labyrinth that looks like an old battlefield: a plain of young green winter wheat, a great white wall with a gate far behind on the left, a row of boundary stones running across the field toward a brass-coloured glow on the horizon. On either side, grey-faced soldiers of two armies stand in ranks under two royal standards with nobody beneath them, and from the back of every soldier a thin pole with a small home banner stands up. From the right a colossus taller than a city wall has thrown itself forward: a hill of bound grey soldiers and flags with no face, banner poles standing on it as thick as wheat, each arm an enormous sheaf of long spears, two war horns twisted together set in its chest. One arm has just smashed down on a single banner pole planted upright in open ground with a grey cloak tied to it, and from that blow the whole wheat field is lifting in one wave like a blanket being shaken out, the wave racing away toward the white wall, three boundary stones sinking out of sight. In the left foreground, standing exactly on the line of the boundary stones and seen directly from behind, the red-haired tiefling guild master watches with his feet apart: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, no cloak on his shoulders, a pack on his back, his long sword still sheathed at his hip; his right hand is raised to shield his eyes from the flying earth, and his left hand holds a stick of charcoal. No pole grows from his back. Clods of earth and torn green wheat fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头头一手（源稿第437行）：第七天他拿一根倒了的旗杆挑起斗篷，竖进空地里试它，它扑过来，一捆长矛砸下去，麦地从长垒脚下一路掀到裂口，像一张叫人抖起来的毯子，界碑一下沉了三块。它的样子照第435行，用史诗战万旗冢一阶的图当设计参考，没有脸。他身上冒不出旗、一直走在界碑那一线上照第436行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十一层
nodes.name: 掰开号角
nodes.light: a grey sunless sky splitting open down the middle into clear white-gold daylight for the first time, the light falling through the split onto him, grey dusk on both sides
nodes.camera: low in the wheat in front of the opened chest, looking up at him between the two horns, the split sky directly above, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a vast field of grey wheat under a sky that has been grey for longer than anyone remembers, on a deep floor of the labyrinth that looks like an old battlefield; a row of white-and-black boundary stones runs through it. In the middle kneels a colossus as big as a hill, built of nothing but thousands of banner poles, spears and ragged war flags of two armies bound together, with no face; its chest stands open like a gate. Inside the open chest hang two enormous war horns twisted round each other, one of bronze and one of black horn. Between them, inside the chest, stands the red-haired tiefling guild master, facing us: dark red hair come loose from its tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one, his coat in rags, blood on his face, arms and side, a spiral of pale gold light wound round his left arm and gathered into a small ring in his left palm. His arms are spread to their full width, his left hand on the bronze horn and his right hand on the black one, wrenching the two apart, and they have just come untwisted. Directly above him the grey sky is tearing open in a straight line and daylight is pouring through; the wheat is bowing flat away from him on both sides all the way to a far white wall. Behind him on the ground a sword stands planted beside a boundary stone, and from it a narrow path of light runs back across the field, on which a file of small soldiers of two armies stand hand in hand, roped together. Wheat chaff and shreds of flag fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿第408行那一条）：他身上已经没有一处是好的，走完最后半步，两只手攥住那两支拧在一起的号角往两边掰，铜的和黑的分开了，灰了不知多少年的天从当中裂开，头一回亮，麦子向两边伏倒。剑插在界碑脚下、那一线上二十二个人一个东一个西串在绳上照第一、二拍。万旗冢不画脸。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十一层
nodes.name: 斗篷里子
who: the fire-horn captain with bronze-hooped horns
nodes.light: pale winter afternoon light from a tall window falling across the table, warm brown shadow among the chart shelves
nodes.camera: from the far side of the table at the height of the charts, looking over the cloak and the row of seals at the seated man, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter afternoon in the map room of a great guild hall, tall shelves of rolled charts on every wall, one long table under a window. Spread across the table lies a soot-stained grey cloak turned inside out, and on its lining a whole battlefield has been drawn in charcoal: rows of small marks, arrows for the wind, one ring where something kneels. Beside it lies a clean sheet of parchment with the same drawing in ink, line for line. In front of the two drawings, in a neat row, lie twenty-one small brass travel seals. On a plain bench at the far side of the table sits the red-haired tiefling guild master, facing us, in his shirtsleeves: dark red hair tied back in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on one; his right hand holds a pen above the parchment, and his left hand rests open on the table, palm up, with a round burn like a ring in the middle of the palm. He is looking up with a tired half-smile. At the two ends of the table two officers stand facing each other across it. On the left, in full profile facing right, the pale-gold-haired knight captain, a tall straight-backed woman of about forty with short pale gold hair, holds her right hand out open toward him, her left hand on her sword hilt. On the right, in full profile facing left, the fire-horn captain with bronze-hooped horns, tall and lean, close-cropped fiery red hair, one long ochre-red horn sweeping back from each temple, holds his right fist against his chest, his left hand open at his side. In the doorway behind, small, a tall bear-eared woman waits with a coil of rope on her shoulder and a sheathed sword in her arms. Dust motes in the window light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、三拍（源稿第457、459行）：两支兵跟着伯娜背回他的剑、包、斗篷和二十一枚旅印，斗篷里子上的炭图跟他凭记性画的那一张一笔一笔对得上；两边来请他，他坐在长凳上说我不扛旗。左手掌心那个圈、图是右手画的照第457行。两位队长伸手、按胸是我补的请的样子。

nodes.name: 横雨
who: the rabbit-eared guide with the folded ear
nodes.light: a cold grey-white glow inside the curtain of rain on the right, one warm oven fire far behind on the left, wet rock shining between
nodes.camera: low on the wet rock beside the fallen soldier, looking up at the queen and at the ladle stopped in front of her face, the rain blowing straight toward the lens, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in a wide cavern passage, where a curtain of fine grey rain hangs from roof to floor like a wall, and behind it the dim outline of a small station town can almost be made out. The whole curtain has just lunged outward a dozen steps: the rain is flying sideways, flat as blown hair. Out of the rain on the right reaches one long grey arm, with no body that can be seen behind it and no face anywhere, and its hand holds out a wooden water ladle, brim full and perfectly level. The ladle has stopped a hand's width short of a woman's face. She stands in the middle of the picture in full profile facing right, between the ladle and a soldier who has fallen to his hands and knees behind her: the ash-silver-haired demon queen, long straight ash-silver hair blown back by the rain, gold eyes, cold pale skin, a small red mark at her temple, a plain dark travelling coat. Her chin is level and her eyes are on the hand. Her right hand, bare, its glove pulled off, hangs open at her side and takes nothing; her left arm is held out behind her, palm back, keeping the soldier down. She has not moved a step. Further back on the left, in full profile facing left with her back to the rain, the rabbit-eared guide with the folded ear, two long white rabbit ears growing from the very top of her head, one upright and the other folded halfway down; against the rain she wears a close-fitting dark oilcloth hood that covers her whole head and both sides of her face down to the jaw, with two slits in its crown through which the two long white rabbit ears stand out; only her face from brow to chin shows in the opening of the hood, and a thick snow-white braid hangs out of it at the back, stands with her eyes shut tight and both hands gripping a knotted rope that runs to the soldier's waist. Far behind her, small, a horned baker crouches at a little field oven with a glowing door. Sideways rain and flecks of ash streak large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头第二手（源稿第696行）：第七天天黑她领着第六个出来，帘子里那只手攥住了那个兵的后领，整道帘子追着他扑出来十几步，暗窦里的雨下成了横的，瓢一直递到兵的嘴边；她回身挡在兵和瓢中间，没有接，也没有让，那只手停了一口气。妲西背着身守、拿灰径家的结把人拴成一串照第692、693行。递水的只画一只手和瓢，没有脸。她褪了右手的手套照第693行。 11-25 第四手：头一稿达西兔耳以外又多了一对尖耳（立绘没有人耳），写明只有两只兔耳重画。 11-25 第四手：第二稿添了只要兔耳的护栏，达西兔耳下照旧露出一只人耳；第三稿写成两鬓垂着厚头发、把头侧整片盖住。 11-25 第四手：第三稿还是在兔耳下的头发里露出一只小人耳；第四稿给她戴一顶贴头的油布兜帽，两只兔耳从帽顶开口伸出，头侧整个叫兜帽盖住。

nodes.name: 一道横线
who: the pink-haired counter clerk with the monocle
the freckled apprentice with orange curls
nodes.light: warm lamp light over the counter at dusk, deep blue evening in the tall windows behind, a small cold glint on a needle
nodes.camera: at counter height, close on the slip and the ruling pen, the two women above it, the three cloaked backs small in the doorway, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the long counter of a great guild commission hall, lamps just lit, tall windows deep blue. On the counter lies a single slip of paper covered with fine unreadable lines, and beside it a fat leather pouch tied at the neck. On the right, behind the counter and facing us, stands the pink-haired counter clerk with the monocle, a tall slender woman of thirty-two with pale cherry-pink hair pinned up in a bun, a copper pen stuck through it, a monocle on a fine chain over her left eye: her left hand holds a wooden ruler flat across the slip, and her right hand is drawing a pen along it, ruling one straight black line clean across the whole sheet from edge to edge. Her mouth is a thin line. On the left, in front of the counter in full profile facing right, stands the freckled apprentice with orange curls, a small sturdy young woman of twenty, fluffy orange-red hair cut to the jaw, a pencil behind her ear: her left hand is pressed flat over her heart, and her right hand is held out open over the counter with a single steel needle lying on the palm, and the needle has swung round to point back over her shoulder, away from the well. Far behind her, small, three figures in hooded travelling cloaks are walking out of the hall door, seen from behind; the tip of a dark wing shows under one cloak and the brim of a wide hat on another. Lamp motes and a drift of blotting sand hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第二到四拍（源稿第701到703行）：三个裹着斗篷的人递进一张匿名的单子，台面上一只装着五十枚的皮袋；露西揣着一根针找到贝琳达，按着胸口说了照实；贝琳达在单子上划了一道线，会长说划得直。针不朝井照第702行。把递单子和划线并成了一个场面。

nodes.name: 凌空一印
nodes.light: warm station lamps and the glow of a locomotive's firebox on the left, a column of grey rain standing in the middle with every drop hanging still and catching the lamplight, a heavy bronze-gold glow pressing down from the sky above
nodes.camera: low on the platform at the rim of the new well, looking up through the hanging raindrops at her raised hand, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a railway platform of a great walled city, a night train steaming at the left with passengers frozen in its doors. In the middle of the platform a column of grey rain a street wide stands from the paving to the sky, and every drop in it has stopped and hangs in the air. Under it the flagstones have twisted down into the first seven steps of a round well. At the rim of that well the red-haired tiefling guild master kneels on one knee in full profile facing right, his right palm pressed flat on the top step, his left hand on his knee; dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, a grey cloak. On the right stands the ash-silver-haired demon queen, facing us: long straight ash-silver hair, golden eyes, cold pale skin, a small red mark at her temple, a dark travelling robe; her left hand holds a single glove she has just taken off, and her bare right hand is raised, palm down, pressing a square seal of bronze-gold light down through the air. Under that seal the whole night sky over the city has sunk lower, and high in the hanging rain a winged man clutching an open lead box upside down is fixed in mid-flight, the rain spilling from the box frozen with him. Around the platform a ring of white paint has been brushed on the stones, and inside it dozens of people stand with their backs turned to the rain. In the rain itself stands a grey figure holding out a water ladle, with no face. Hanging drops and lamp flares fill the near corners, large and blurred.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第676行那一条）：会长走到那口往下长的井边，一掌平按下去，石阶停在第七级，整根雨柱一滴一滴悬在半空；她褪下右手的手套，凌空压下一方印，城西的夜空低了一截，飞到墙头的夜翼连匣子连半空悬着的雨一齐定住。托米拉刷的白线、背过身的人照第三拍。递水的这一拍不画脸。640年的会长是吉迪恩。

nodes.name: 眉心一按
nodes.light: the grey-blue hour before a midwinter dawn, one cold lamp over the gate, frost on the paving, no warm light anywhere
nodes.camera: from the paving a little to one side, at the height of her raised hand, the three scholars in a row and the shut gate behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the grey hour before dawn in midwinter, at the tall iron-bound gate of a research institute built of dark stone; frost lies on the paving and one lamp burns over the shut gate. In front of the gate three people in scholars' coats stand in a row with empty hands. Nearest, in full profile facing left, is the night-wing scholar, a lean man who looks about thirty-five, grey-white hair combed neatly, pale yellow owl-like eyes, a lean face with no deep lines; his wings are an owl's feathered wings, grey-brown and speckled, folded tight and hidden under his long charcoal robe so that only the speckled feather tips show below its hem: feathers, not leathery bat wings, no skin membrane anywhere, his eyes open and fixed straight ahead. Beyond him stands a very tall bull-horned man with his head bowed, and beyond him a slight woman in a hooded coat with her hands clasped. Facing the first of them, in full profile facing right, stands the ash-silver-haired demon queen, alone, with no guard and no crown: long straight ash-silver hair, gold eyes, cold pale skin, a small red mark at her temple, a long dark coat of state buttoned to the throat. She has taken off both gloves and holds them folded in her left hand. Her bare right hand is raised to the height of his face with the thumb held out, a finger's width from the middle of his brow, not yet touching. Her face is perfectly still, and her lips are parted, asking him his name. Beside the gate a tall slab of dark stone is cut with rows of fine unreadable marks. Far down the empty street behind her, small, three house doors each show one lit window. Frost crystals and the lamp's pale halo drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第四拍（源稿第721行）：寒星月上旬一日天亮以前，研究院的院门口，她一个人走来，摘了手套，一个一个问了名字，拇指在三个人眉心各按了一下，三个人像睡着了，没有再醒；那一冬三家的门是她自己去敲的；法碑上添了一条。画的是拇指还没按上去的一下，不画倒下。 11-25 第四手：头一稿居伊背上画成了一对蝙蝠膜翼（立绘是藏在长袍下的灰褐斑点鸮羽），写明鸮羽、藏在袍下重画。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十六层的路标
nodes.name: 两道白线
nodes.light: the first clear gold light of a cold morning from the left, long shadows of two rows of people across the flagstones, pale mist rising out of the well
nodes.camera: low between the two white lines, looking along the gap at the three in the middle, the two rows running away on both sides, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: first light at the mouth of the great well, a round stone-railed shaft as wide as a town square, an iron lift cage hanging at its lip. On the flagstones two fresh white lines have been painted side by side, three steps apart, and eighty-three armed people stand along them in two rows facing each other across the gap: on the left line human soldiers in blue-and-white tabards, on the right line horned demon-kin soldiers in black and bronze. Only three people stand in the gap. In the middle, facing us, the tall thin map-maker, a man of thirty-eight with messy dark brown-black hair shot through with silver, a long coat, a case of rolled charts on his back, his left eye a pale crystal, holds his right hand up with three fingers raised and an open notebook against his chest in his left hand. On the left of him, in full profile facing right, the honey-curled army clerk, a woman with short curly honey-gold hair and a spare pen behind her ear, writes with her right hand on a board that rests on her left forearm. On the right of him, in full profile facing left, the four-armed silver-scaled clerk, a tall lean demon-kin with fine silvery-white scales and four arms, counts along the row: his upper right hand points with a pen, his upper left hand holds a ledger, his lower right hand holds a small hourglass and his lower left hand a lantern. At the head of the right-hand row a broad fire-horn woman with clay-red skin shoulders a pole of copper-bronze a man and a half tall, a crystal lamp at its tip. In the corner, small, a woman squats repainting the end of a white line with a brush. Dawn mist and chalk dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第三、五拍和幕终（源稿第1017、1019、1020行）：奥尔文只定了一条，每过一道雾门三个人各报一回层数，三个数一样才往本子上写；中旬四日拂晓八十三个人在井口列成东西两排，隔着三步，地上刷两道白线；久洛报数，策琳记名。坎黛丝扛着路标照第1018行。久洛是深潮蛇魔，四条胳膊照设定。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十六层的路标
nodes.name: 一堆火
nodes.light: one single campfire warm on a ring of faces, a wall of pale standing fog glowing faintly behind, black rock above
nodes.camera: low across the fire, the two clerks close on the near side, the map-maker's back and the fog gate beyond, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night deep underground on the fifty-fifth floor of the labyrinth, before a tall arch in a rock wall that is filled from top to bottom with standing fog. On the wall to the left of the arch seven vertical streaks are scored in the rock; to the right of it lies a fallen black pillar. In front of the arch burns one single campfire, and round it eighty-odd soldiers of two armies, blue-and-white tabards and black-and-bronze, sit mixed together shoulder to shoulder, sharing bread, their emptied water flasks stacked in one heap. In the foreground, on the near side of the fire and facing us, two clerks sit side by side and have swapped books. On the left the honey-curled army clerk, short curly honey-gold hair, a short red thread tied round the pen behind her ear, holds his ledger open in both hands and reads it with her brows raised. On the right the four-armed silver-scaled clerk, tall and lean, fine silvery-white scales, holds her notebook open in his two upper hands, while his lower right hand signs a line at the bottom of the page with a pen and his lower left hand steadies a small hourglass on his knee; he is almost smiling. Behind them, standing and seen directly from behind, the tall thin map-maker in a long coat faces the fog: his right hand is flat on the rock beside the seven streaks, his left hand holds a lantern low at his side. Planted in the ground beside the fire stands a pole of copper-bronze a man and a half tall with a crystal lamp at its tip, unlit. Sparks and threads of fog drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第七拍和幕终（源稿第1029、1030行）：雾门左手边的墙上七道竖纹，右手边倒着一根黑柱；久洛数完说七道，你父亲那本数对了，策琳照原话记下请他签名，他签了；下旬八日队伍在雾门跟前坐下把水喝完，当夜两边只生了一堆火。两人换本子看照第1024行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十六层的路标
nodes.name: 横臂
who: the fire-horn woman with the machine arm
the map-maker with one eye socket empty
nodes.light: her horn fire turning the narrow lane red-orange, a hundred thin rings of white-blue light blazing on the paving behind, two pale sheets of white mist at the lane's end
nodes.camera: inside the closing lane at knee height, looking up at her braced arm with people ducking under it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a narrow stone lane in a city that has no sky, its walls half white stone and half black glass; the two walls of the lane are swinging together like the covers of a closing book, and the paving slabs behind are standing up on edge one after another. At the far end of the lane hang two sheets of white mist. Across the closing gap, at shoulder height, a heavy mechanical arm of brass and steel is jammed crosswise and locked, holding the walls apart. It belongs to the fire-horn woman with the machine arm, who stands braced under it facing us: two horns curving back from her temples in copper sleeves with glowing vents, both horns blazing, a thick braid black at the root and orange-red at the end, the socket of the machine arm at her right shoulder ticking with sparks, her left hand flat against the wall, her teeth set. Under the arm, soldiers of two armies in a chain, each gripping the belt of the one in front, are ducking through toward the mist. Behind her, down the lane, two flat grey hands as tall as doors press on the two walls, and between them stands a man-high grey figure whose face is flat and blank like a face painted on a board. In the foreground, crouched at a crack in the paving in full profile facing right, the map-maker with one eye socket empty, messy dark hair shot with silver, draws the last stroke of a line on the stone with a crystal pen in his right hand, his left hand shielding a small glass eye wedged in the crack that shines white like a coal; around it more than a hundred concentric lines of light are all flaring at once. Stone grit and sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七、八拍（源稿第1000行那一条）：它两只平平的手按上窄道两边的墙，往当中一合，像合上一本图册；坎黛丝把电械的胳膊横进缝里，锁住，角上的火烧到最旺，后头的人从胳膊底下一个一个钻过去；奥尔文蹲在石缝跟前画完了最后一道线，一百一十九圈亮线一齐亮起来。第八十四个脸是平的，照原文写成一张画上去的平脸。奥尔文左眼的义眼按在石缝里，写成左眼眶空着。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第五十六层的路标
nodes.name: 踩花的线
who: the fire-horn woman with the empty sleeve
nodes.light: a cold bright winter noon, white sun on the flagstones, steam from a kitchen door, breath showing in the air
nodes.camera: low on the flagstones at the smudged white lines, boots crossing them in the foreground, the bench and the two walkers above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a cold bright winter noon at the mouth of the great well. The iron lift cage stands open at the lip, and soldiers are pouring out of it across the flagstones: blue-and-white tabards and black-and-bronze all mixed together, filthy, thin, laughing with tiredness, some holding one another up by the belt, walking straight over two white lines painted side by side on the stones and smudging them with their boots. On the left, on a plain bench, the red-haired tiefling guild master sits in full profile facing right: dark red hair tied back in one tail, two swept-back horns, a grey cloak; his right hand is cupped beside his mouth as he shouts toward a steaming kitchen door, and his left hand lies flat on the bench. In the middle, walking toward us and facing us, come two people side by side. The fire-horn woman with the empty sleeve, tall and broad-shouldered, clay-red skin, two horns curving back from her temples, has her right sleeve pinned up empty at the shoulder and her left arm round the shoulders of the man beside her. He is the tall thin map-maker, dark hair shot with silver, a strip of clean cloth tied over his own left eye only (the eye on the right side of the picture as he faces us), his right eye open, a long torn coat; both his hands hang empty at his sides, and he carries no chart and no pole. Behind them, small, a clerk with honey-gold curls and the four-armed clerk walk together (he has an ordinary handsome human face and rose-red hair in one long braid, fine silvery-white scales only on his neck and forearms, four arms; not a lizard or dragon head, no spines, no snout), each carrying the other's book. In the corner a woman with a paint pot and a brush glares at the trampled lines. Breath, kitchen steam and flecks of old white paint drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第三拍（源稿第1047行）：初雪月下旬一日回到井口，出笼的人没有照东西两排站，踩着那两道白线混着出来，托米拉嘟囔踩花了她还得再刷一遍；会长在长凳上一排一排看过去，冲食堂喊八十三份，热的。路标没立住、图烧了照第1048行，所以他两手空着。坎黛丝的右臂照三幕没了、第二年开春才装新的，奥尔文左眼照第1050行蒙着布。 11-25 第四手：头一稿奥尔文的布蒙在右眼上，后头那位四臂书记画成了蜥蜴头的龙人（立绘是红发人脸、颈和臂上银鳞），写明重画。

nodes.name: 背门槛
nodes.light: strong summer afternoon sun raking down the cliff face from the upper left, white spray from the falls full of light, deep blue shadow in the mine mouths below
nodes.camera: from a lower turn of the cliff stair looking steeply up at him coming down under the stone, the cliff houses and the falls towering behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer afternoon on a colossal cliff face in dwarf country, a wall of rock a mile high with a waterfall the colour of iron thundering down one side of it. Houses are cut into the cliff in tiers, joined by plank-ways and stone stairs. All down the stairs dwarf families are carrying their homes away on their backs: pots, rolled bedding, a cradle, a goat on a rope. In the foreground, coming down the stair and facing us, is the rust-bearded dwarf shield-bearer, short but as wide as a wall, short rust-copper hair grey at the temples, a big braided rust-copper beard, in a plain work shirt with the sleeves rolled. On his back he carries one huge worn slab of stone, the doorstep of a house, held in a rope sling across his chest: both his hands grip the rope at his shoulders, he is bent under the weight, and he is grinning through his beard. Beside him on the stair, in full profile facing left and looking up at the stone, a dwarf neighbour woman with a bundle on her head points at it with her free right hand and laughs. Above them, on a timber frame bolted to the rock, hangs a great bronze bell, and under it stands the red-braided dwarf bell-keeper, short and stout, rust-red hair in two thick braids coiled on her head, facing us with both hands holding the bell rope still. Far below, small, a line of miners is still walking in at a mine mouth. Spray from the falls and rock dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第七拍（源稿第1348行）：崖面上的人家背着锅和被褥往下搬，哪一家搬不动，麦格尼折回去背；石雷家当门槛的那块大石头也叫他背下来了，邻居笑他背的是门槛，他说门槛在，家就在。矿上的班照旧下照第1344行。断根没画进这一幅。

nodes.name: 吞火
nodes.light: a river of orange-white molten slag on the floor lighting everything from below, the stream of fire bending upward into one man's mouth, black rock and timber above
nodes.camera: low on the gallery floor behind the stretchers, looking along the fire at the dwarf and past him at the thing in the roof, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep in a dwarf mine, in a narrow gallery shored with heavy timber. A stone channel in the wall has been bitten open and molten slag is spilling out of it, and a stream of fire is racing along the gallery floor toward us. From the broken roof at the far end hangs the front of an enormous burrowing thing as thick as the gallery itself, armoured in overlapping plates of raw ore, eyeless, its head nothing but a ring of grinding stone teeth; rubble pours down round it. In the middle of the gallery stands the red-bearded dwarf fire-keeper in full profile facing right, short and very broad, a great red beard smoking and burnt short at its end: his head is thrown back and his mouth is wide open, and the whole stream of fire is lifting off the floor in front of him and pouring into his mouth like water down a drain. Both his fists are clenched at his sides and his boots are planted. Behind him on the left, at the near edge of the picture, four miners crouch over two stretchers and shield the wounded with their backs. Under the belly of the thing on the right, in full profile facing right, the pomegranate-haired tiefling lancer has slid in on one knee: short pomegranate-red hair in a small knot, two short forehead horns curving back; with both hands she drives a long lance upward into the seam between two ore plates, where the broken shaft of an older spear is wedged, and pale light bursts out of the seam. Sparks, drops of slag and stone chips fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第1356行）：中旬二日第六层，断根从顶上啃下来，把撤上来的那一班堵在一道窄道里，咬破了锻台往下淌的熔渣沟，火顺着窄道朝担架扑过去；邓巴尔张嘴把那一道火吸了回去，胡子烧短了一截；菲莱雅钻到它肚子底下，认出了壳缝里那杆断枪，长枪顺着两片矿壳中间的缝挑进去。断根的样子照矿壳、没有眼睛写。

nodes.name: 天墙
nodes.light: grey dawn light cut off by a wall of falling rock overhead, the red glow of a thousand forge fires far below all dipping at once, a pale shimmer running from the shield down through his body into the ground
nodes.camera: at the dwarf's boots looking straight up along the shield at the cliff coming down, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn on the face of an enormous cliff ringed with hundreds of waterfalls, above a city of forges. A timber plank road is pinned along the cliff, and far along it, small, a hundred miners and a line of stretcher carts are running. A mine mouth opens in the rock on the left, plugged by the huge armoured back of some burrowing thing. Above everything, the whole upper face of the cliff has come away from the mountain and is dropping like a wall hung from the sky, the waterfalls bent sideways by it. At the mine-mouth end of the plank road stands the rust-bearded dwarf shield-bearer, alone, seen from below and facing us: short and as wide as a wall, short rust-copper hair grey at the temples, a big braided rust-copper beard; both arms hold a tower shield of pale ancient dragon bone flat above his head, tilted a little, his heels driven into the stone, his knees sunk into the rock to the shin. The first wave of boulders has just struck the shield, and instead of breaking him the force is running down through his body into the ground as a visible pale shock, cracking the rock outward from his feet and rolling away into the roots of the mountain like thunder under the earth. His face is set and calm. On the plank road behind him, in full profile facing right and running, the pomegranate-haired tiefling lancer, short red hair in a knot, two short brow horns with the left tip broken, a long thin tail, pushes the last stretcher cart with both hands, with no lance. Far below, the fires of the forge city. Rock dust and waterfall spray fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第1329行那一条）：整面崖离开了山，像一堵从天上垂下来的墙朝栈道压；麦格尼站在矿口那一头，把古龙骨粉塔盾举过头顶，两个膝盖陷进了岩里，盾面一斜，那一股劲顺着他的身子走进地里，像雷在地底下滚。菲莱雅把枪留在断根肚子里、推着最后一辆车上了栈道照第四拍。

nodes.name: 发亮的缝
nodes.light: cold blue winter daylight on a new scar of bare rock, a warm forge glow from the left, one bright line of light down the middle of the shield
nodes.camera: low in front of the shield, the bright seam running up the middle of the frame, his face above its rim, the pinned rock behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter morning at the foot of a colossal cliff in dwarf country. Half the cliff is gone: where tiers of houses and a great waterfall used to be there is one raw new face of rock, clean as a cut, and a slope of fallen stone as big as a hill below it. At the bottom, a mine mouth has been opened again in the old rock, and the stone round it is studded with rows of thick iron pins, each pin driven through a carved rune that still glows faintly. In front of the mine mouth, facing us, stands the rust-bearded dwarf shield-bearer, short but as wide as a wall, short rust-copper hair grey at the temples, a big braided rust-copper beard, in plain heavy armour. He holds a great tower shield upright in front of him with its foot on the ground, his left arm through its straps and his right hand resting on its top rim. The shield has been broken once and forged whole again: a single seam runs down its middle from rim to foot, and the seam has been left bright, a thin line of polished metal that catches the light. His face is calm and tired. Behind him on the left, small, a red-bearded dwarf with a magnifying lens over one eye swings a hammer at one more pin, and a row of name tags hangs on hooks on a board by the mine mouth, every hook filled. Snow dust and a few forge sparks drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束末两拍（源稿第1376、1377行）：那面盾从中间裂了一道，布洛姆加说你接的山你自己补，那一冬他在断崖的锻台上自己重打；崖底下那几层矿道，索林·炉环带着符文一支一锤一锤钉了回去，麦格尼立在钉回去的矿道口，手里那面重打过的盾，中间留着一条发亮的缝。牌全挂回了钩子照第1372行。

nodes.name: 问门的
nodes.light: a cold bright blue sky like glass, white cracks of starlight running across it, pale glowing flower lamps along a white street, long soft shadows
nodes.camera: low on the white steps beside the girl, looking down the street at the crowd with lifted faces and the one bowed figure, the cracked sky filling the top of the frame, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a dream. A city of white houses stands under a sky like an upturned bowl of blue glass, and the street lamps are tall flowers that glow as they open. The sky is cracking: long bright cracks run across it one after another, and through the cracks stars are falling slowly, like broken glass. In the white street hundreds of people in pale, old-fashioned clothes stand quite still with their faces lifted to the sky. Only one figure does not look up. In the middle distance a tall thin grey shape in a long coat walks bent forward, its head bowed so low that no face can be seen, one long hand held out in front of it feeling along a wall for a door, and behind it it drags a long train of pale shadows shaped like sleeping people. In the foreground, on the white steps of a house, stands the straw-haired dog-eared apprentice, a girl of sixteen with wheat-yellow hair, soft drooping dog ears of the same colour growing high on the top of her head and hanging down flat over the sides of it, broad and long enough to cover the whole side of her head from temple to jaw, with loose wheat-yellow hair falling over them as well, so that nothing of the side of her head shows but fur and hair and a yellow tail with a white tip, in a plain long-sleeved nightgown to the ankles and a wool shawl. She stands in full profile facing right, watching the grey shape: both her hands clutch the shawl together at her chest, her eyes are wide, and there are tears on her cheek; she is unhurt and nothing touches her. Slivers of falling starlight drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一、二拍（源稿第1606、1607行）：葵恩梦里站在一座白房子的城里，天一道一道裂开，星星像碎玻璃往下掉，满城的人抬着头，只有一个人不抬头，挨个问人门在哪边；三条街的孩子管它叫问门的。街灯是开着就亮的花、天像倒扣的蓝玻璃照第1615行。它身后拖着做梦的人的影子照第1616行。葵恩十六岁，只是站着看。问门的低着头、不画脸。 11-25 第四手：头一稿昆恩垂着的狗耳底下又露出一只人耳（立绘没有人耳），写明重画。 11-25 第四手：第二稿昆恩狗耳根下还是露出一点人耳，第三稿写成垂耳又宽又长、把头侧整片盖住，再垂着头发。

nodes.name: 头一针
who: the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair
nodes.light: one warm oil lamp held high on the left throwing long shadows across the floorboards, a thin cold blue light under the door on the right, a bright point where the needle goes in
nodes.camera: at floor level along the stretched shadow, close on the needle and her hand, the bed and the three adults above, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a small apprentices' bedroom with a stove and a narrow bed. In the bed a girl of sixteen with wheat-yellow hair and drooping dog ears lies asleep under a quilt, safe and unhurt. But her shadow does not lie where it should: it is stretched thin right across the floorboards toward the door on the right, as if something were pulling it out under the door, and under the door shows a line of cold blue light and the tips of four long grey fingers hooked into the shadow's edge. At the foot of the bed, kneeling in full profile facing right, is the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair, honey-gold hair loosely put up and pinned with a few plain steel needles, sleeves rolled: with her right hand she has just driven a steel needle threaded with a faintly glowing thread down through the shadow into the floorboard, and with her left hand she holds the shadow flat like cloth; where the needle goes in, the shadow has stopped sliding. Behind her, standing and facing us, the pearl-haired dream doctor, long pearl-white hair tinged violet at the ends and tied at the nape, half-lidded honey-coloured eyes, has his right hand raised with the knuckles bent as if knocking on a door that is not there, his left hand held out toward her. On the left, in full profile facing right, the grizzled dog-eared father, a weathered man with pricked dog ears and a bushy tail, holds an oil lamp up high in his right hand and grips the bedpost with his left, his jaw tight. Lamp motes and loose ends of thread drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第二、三拍（源稿第1616、1617行）：问门的抢在两个人前头出了葵恩的门，身后拖着做梦的人的影子；米蕾卡顺着门缝的光摸到葵恩的影子，头一针落下去，把影子钉回了床脚，问门的叫针脚挤出来，顺着线退回了裂口。泰里昂进别人的梦先叩门照第1615行。把梦里和屋里并成了屋里的一个场面。葵恩睡在床上，不受伤；门底下只画几根指尖。

nodes.name: 星梯缝影
who: the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair
nodes.light: frozen stars hanging in a stair, each a point of blue-white light, a deep violet dream sky with one torn corner, the pale petals of the city glowing faintly from below
nodes.camera: from the foot of the star stair looking up it, the mender coming down toward us, the shadow giant on the right, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night inside a shared dream: a city whose houses are shaped like the closed white calyxes of flowers, under a deep violet sky. One corner of the sky above the east gate has been torn, and from the roofs up to that tear climbs a stair made of falling stars that have been frozen in mid-air, step above step, each with a rim of frost. A long line of small sleepers in nightclothes is climbing the star stair toward the sky, holding a rope. Coming down the same stair toward us, in the middle of the picture, is the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair: honey-gold hair loosely put up and held with a few steel sewing needles, tired amber eyes, a plain work dress; her right hand holds a long threaded needle raised, her left hand draws out a single strand of shadow like a thread, and her own shadow, cast up the stair behind her, is many times larger than she is. On the right, standing at the city gate and as tall as the city wall, is a figure made of hundreds of long shadows twisted together like a rope, with no face; its legs are locked in frost, one of its hands is pinned to the gate tower by a stone wedge, and where the mender has passed, its twisted shadows are coming loose one by one and trailing after her needle. On the gate tower, small, a woman holds the torn corner of the sky up with a wedge; on a roof a young man with a little bell on the tip of his tail stands still. Frost crystals and star-glitter drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿第1592行那一条）：雷斯坦的霜冻住它的腿，蓓萝的楔钉住它的手，维勒的铃多停了一拍，米蕾卡顺着星梯走下来，把那些影子一条一条挑开，一条一针缝回裂口；她每缝一针自己的影子就大一圈照第二拍。问门的是几百条影子拧成的，不画脸。梦里的人画成穿睡衣的小人。

nodes.name: 替她提灯
who: the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair
nodes.light: one lantern held high between tall dark houses, warm gold on three faces and on the paving, deep blue night beyond, a faint glitter of threads in the dark of an alley
nodes.camera: low on the paving in front of them, their three shadows running toward the lens, the lantern high in the frame, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late night in the upper ring of the dungeon city, a narrow street of tall stone houses with most of the windows dark. Three people are walking toward us along the middle of the street. In the middle, facing us, is the honey-haired mender with needles in her hair, a woman of thirty-four with honey-gold hair loosely put up and pinned with a few plain steel needles, warm amber eyes, tired and smiling a little, a sewing basket on her left arm and her right hand resting on the shoulder of the girl beside her. On the left of her, facing us, walks the straw-haired dog-eared apprentice, a girl of sixteen with wheat-yellow hair, soft drooping dog ears and a yellow tail with a white tip: with both hands she holds a lantern up on a short pole, as high as she can reach, and she looks very pleased with the job. On the right, facing us, walks the grizzled dog-eared father, a weathered man with pricked dog ears and a bushy tail, a second lantern, unlit, hanging from his left hand, his right hand loose at his side. On the paving in front of them lie their three shadows, and the mender's is fainter than the other two; its edge frays into fine bright threads that trail away toward the dark mouth of an alley, where they glint like a far-off constellation. Behind them, small, the iron door of a vault is shut and barred, and no one sleeps beside it. Moths and lantern motes drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍（源稿第1637行）：天一黑，没有灯的地方，她的影子散进黑里；打那以后夜里没有灯的路她不一个人走，葵恩和加斯帕轮着替她提灯。封存库守夜的人不睡在库里照第1639行。影子的边散成线是我补的看得见的样子。

nodes.name: 断拱
nodes.light: cold blue night, the track lamps going dark one by one into the distance, white foam of river water rearing over the bridge, one orange flash from a cannon at the train's tail
nodes.camera: low on the carriage roof in front of the running soldier, the broken arch and the hanging engine behind him, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a great stone railway bridge of nine arches over a wide river. The middle arch has just broken and dropped into the river; river water is rearing up backwards over the bridge deck on both sides, and all along the track the lamps on their posts are going dark one after another into the distance. A long train stands on the bridge with its engine hanging out over the broken gap, held back by long ropes lashed from each carriage to the bridge piers. On the far side of the gap, small but clear, a tall masked figure in a dark cloak stands on the rails with a long halberd held upright. In the foreground, running toward us along the roofs of the carriages, away from the gap, comes the grey wolf-eared soldier, facing us: messy charcoal-grey hair, grey wolf ears laid back, a short bitten-off tail, a worn soldier's coat. On his back he carries the frost-haired bell-keeper, a pale woman with frost-white hair cut to the shoulders and blue-green eyes: her right arm is round his neck, her left hand clutches a thick sealed register against his shoulder, and a small metal name tag on a cord swings at her throat. Both his hands are hooked under her knees, and his teeth are bared with effort. Behind them on the roofs, small, four fighters haul on a rope, and at the tail of the train soldiers have swung a crystal cannon round. Spray and sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头头一手（源稿第1879、1880行）：车到九拱桥当中，前后十几里轨上的星纱灯一路灭了过去，河水倒卷上桥面，当中那一拱整个断进了河里，车头悬在断口上；断口那一头站着一个蒙面的高个子，手里一杆长戟；送行的星拿长绳把车厢一节一节拴上桥墩，雷夫背起梅芙从车顶往桥东跑。封存册和铭牌照第1878行。

nodes.name: 红线名册
nodes.light: tall white daylight falling from a dome onto pale stone, a faint glow from a round seal in the table, the benches in soft shadow
nodes.camera: low beside the oath table, close on the open roster and the hand on the seal, the judge on the high seat above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day in a great court hall of pale stone under a high dome, the public benches full, a long bench of jurors at one side. In the middle of the floor stands a small oath table with a round seal of white metal set in its top. At the table, in full profile facing right, stands the pale-gold-curled young officer, twenty-one, pale gold curly hair, lake-blue eyes, in a plain soldier's coat with no rank on it: his left hand is pressed flat on the seal, which glows faintly, and his right hand holds a worn roster book open toward the high seat. Down its pages run columns of fine unreadable names, and under many of them a line has been ruled in red ink; not one name is struck out. His face is white and set. On the high seat beyond the table, facing us, sits the black-haired presiding judge, long straight black hair with a cold blue sheen falling along both cheeks, a judge's dark robe, bolt upright. Over each of her eyes, over each ear and in the middle of her brow sits a round seal of dull black wax. Her right hand is stretched out palm upward to be given the book, and her left hand rests on the arm of the seat. At the left edge, in full profile facing right, the white-haired nobleman, white hair cropped very short, in rich dark clothes, has risen from the defendants' bench with both hands gripping the rail. On the floor a wooden chest has split open and spilled thousands of identical slips. Among the jurors, small, a weathered woman with a netting needle stuck in her hair leans forward. Dust motes in the dome light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第六、七拍（源稿第1892、1893行）：辩护士抬上来一箱报死的单子，四千零七十一张；箱子穿了；二十一岁的伊曼纽·苍麦自己走到证誓桌前，拿出苍麦营的另一本名册，死了的人名字底下画一道红线，名字没划掉；提奥巴尔德·采林根站起来按住圣印。维多利亚两眼、两耳、眉心各压着一枚黑蜡照第1889行，拿一张放在我手上照第1892行。

nodes.name: 落蜡
nodes.light: the red-gold sun setting directly behind her, her long shadow thrown straight down the black stair toward us, rim light on her hair and on the falling flakes of wax
nodes.camera: from several steps below her on the stair, inside her shadow, looking up past the halted halberd at her face, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunset on a grand stair of black glass-stone that climbs to the door of a court of law on a high terrace; a gate tower beside it is split from top to bottom and half fallen, and the stair is cracked from the gate up to its ninth step. On each of thirty-two steps a sheet of parchment is fixed to the stone with one bronze-gold nail. On the top step stands the black-haired presiding judge, facing us: long straight black hair with a blue sheen falling along both cheeks, a judge's dark robe; her eyes have just opened, grey-blue and steady, and flakes of pale sealing wax are dropping from her eyelids, from her ears and from the middle of her brow onto the black stone. Her left hand hangs at her side; her right hand is held by the red-curled halfling clerk, a small round-faced man with carrot-red curls who stands at her right side facing us, his other hand still pressed against the back of her hand where he has been writing with a fingertip, a small hammer thrust in his belt. One step below her, seen directly from behind, a huge commander in dark plate armour with a black glove on his right hand has his halberd raised in both hands, and it has stopped in the air a pace from her; ropes are wound round his legs and waist, and hundreds of unarmed soldiers down the stair hold the other ends, leaning back. One corner of the top step is freshly broken off. Her shadow runs from her feet down over all thirty-two sheets and everyone on the stair. Wax flakes and sunset dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿第1861行那一条）：第三十二颗钉子敲进去，她眼皮上的蜡先裂了，跟着是耳朵上的，眉心的，一块一块落在黑曜石上；汉诺的戟停在半空，等她开口认他；太阳正落到法庭的屋脊后头，她的影子从最上一级铺下来，铺过三十二张判词和阶上所有的人。庞托牵着她的右手、在她手背上写字照第一、五拍；旧兵拿绳缠着汉诺照第六拍。汉诺·塞费特没有立绘，画成背影。

nodes.name: 铅笔状子
nodes.light: a clear late-autumn afternoon, low gold sun across terraced fields, long shadows of dry wheat stubble, blue hills beyond
nodes.camera: low at the grave among the stubble, close on the stone and the folded paper under it, the two women above against the sky, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear late-autumn afternoon on a hillside cut into terraces of harvested wheat, stubble gold in the low sun, a few stone farmhouses below. On one terrace, at the foot of a dry-stone wall, is a small old grave with a plain headstone, and beside it a fresh second mound. Kneeling at the old grave, in full profile facing right, is the frost-haired bell-keeper, a pale woman with frost-white hair to the shoulders: with both hands she is hanging a small worn metal name tag by its cord over the corner of the headstone, her right hand settling the tag, her left hand holding the cord. Standing beside her, in full profile facing left, is the black-haired judge, long straight black hair with a cold blue sheen, grey-blue eyes, in a plain dark travelling coat, with no wax and no robe: she bends forward and with her right hand slides a folded sheet of paper, grey with old pencil writing, under a flat stone on top of the grave, her left hand holding back her hair. Her face is quiet. On the path below the terrace, small, five tired fighters with a wolf-eared man among them wait beside a cart loaded with a chest of hundreds of the same small tags. Wheat chaff and thistle seed drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第五拍（源稿第1913行）：梅芙和送行的星把铭牌一家一家送回去；于尔根·加尔伯那一块送到苍麦一处梯田坡上的坟前，他母亲680年冬天就没了；维多利亚跟着去了，把那张铅笔写的状子压在坟头的石头底下。她的眼睛耳朵那时已经好了照第1910行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·两边的名单
nodes.name: 绳仓的梦
nodes.light: dim brown dream light with no source, a small red point of incense on a roof beam just going out, smoke-pink haze above, the corners of the room folding into dark
nodes.camera: from the floor between the two rows, looking up past the thief at the woman on the beam, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a dream of an old rope warehouse: bare brick, heaps of rotten hemp, a door frame notched with hundreds of short cuts from the floor to chest height, everything too dim and too still. Two long rows of people stand in it back to back, one row facing left and one row facing right, men and women in work clothes, all with their arms at their sides and their eyes shut. Only two are different: in the row facing left a lanky young man with very short ink-blue hair has turned his head to look round, and at the front of the row facing right a young woman with a thick wheat-coloured braid stands with her eyes wide open. Up on a roof beam sits a woman with smoke-pink curls in a wide-sleeved gown, her ankles crossed: from her left hand a pierced brass incense ball hangs on a chain, and with two fingers of her right hand she is pinching out a stub of incense stuck in the beam, a last thread of smoke curling from it. She is smiling down. Below her, between the rows, in full profile facing right, stands the shadow-walking thief: long black-violet hair falling ragged from under a dark hood, deep violet eyes with a faint glow, close dark clothes. Her face is tilted up to the beam; her right hand is stretched toward the lanky young man's shoulder and has not reached it, her left hand is open at her side. At the edges the whole room is beginning to fold shut like a closing book, the walls bending inward. Threads of pink smoke and hemp dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五到七拍（源稿第2210到2212行）：梦里还是绳仓，两排人，一排朝东，一排朝西；朝西那一排里一个瘦高的少年回过头，朝东那一排最前头一个睁着眼的姑娘；梁上坐着一个烟粉色卷发的女人，提一只镂空的铜香球，她拿两根指头掐灭了香头，梦一下子合上。门框里侧的刻痕照第2207行。梁上那一位没有立绘，照源稿写的样子。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·两边的名单
nodes.name: 水墙
who: the bull-horned gate-keeper with the steelyard
nodes.light: red and cold blue tube lamps mirrored in wet black glass paving, a burst of white sparks where a row of lamps has blown, the water wall lit from inside
nodes.camera: low on the wet paving at the edge of the channel beside the kneeling judge, looking up the face of the water wall at the fist bulging through it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a wet night in the workshop quarter of a volcanic city: narrow back lanes paved with black volcanic glass that mirrors tube lamps of red and cold blue, and a whole row of those lamps has just burst in a shower of sparks. At the end of the lane stands a low windowless workshop with an iron door, and half of its front wall has been punched out from inside. Around the whole building a wall of water has risen out of a cooling channel and closed into a ring three storeys high, clear and trembling, small fish and lamp light caught inside it. On the right, kneeling at the edge of the channel in full profile facing left, is the ink-blue-haired deep-tide judge: long ink-blue hair tied at the nape with a cord, pale water-green eyes, a line of fine scales along his jaw, a judge's dark coat. His right hand is plunged to the wrist in the channel water, his left hand is spread flat on a bundle of documents on the kerb, and his face is calm. On the left, seen through the water from inside the ring and facing us, the bull-horned gate-keeper with the steelyard, a huge demon-kin with thick bull horns and a weighing steelyard hooked at his belt, drives his right fist into the water wall; the water bulges outward round the fist and holds, and his left arm is drawn back for another blow. Far down the lane, small, workers have come to their doors to stare. Drops of water and sparks of broken glass fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手和下一拍（源稿第2222、2223行）：秤钩一拳砸穿了半面墙，整条阴巷的灯管炸了一排；斯托扬把手按进冷却渠，整条渠的水立起来，围着作坊合成一圈三层楼高的水墙，人和声音都出不去，秤钩第二拳砸在水上，水墙往外鼓了一下，又合严了。火山玻璃的路面和两色灯管照第2218行，约的抄本照同一行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·两边的名单
nodes.name: 灯影离墙
nodes.light: a row of warm gallery lamps on the left wall, pale incense smoke creeping back along the floor, the red glow of a stove mouth low on the right
nodes.camera: low in the gallery outside the study door, looking along the wall of lamps as their shadows leave it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the small hours of the night in a rich town house during a ball. Through an arch on the left, small, a ballroom full of guests in evening dress who have all fallen asleep on their feet, the musicians' bows stopped on the strings; pale incense smoke lies ankle-deep on the floor and is flowing backward toward us. In the foreground is an upper gallery lit by a row of wall lamps, ending at the door of a study. Every lamp bracket along the wall throws a long shadow, and all those shadows have peeled away from the wall and whipped across the gallery like ropes: they are wound round the wrists and ankles of an elegant woman in a dark ball gown with pinned-up hair, pinning her flat against the study door, her mouth open in outrage, her right hand empty and open. A man with a gold chain round his neck sleeps slumped against the door frame. In front of her, rising out of a pool of shadow on the floor and seen from the knees up, facing us, is the shadow-walking thief, half her body still dissolving into the dark: in her left hand she holds up a small pierced silver incense ball on a chain, a last thread of smoke curling from it, and under her right arm she clamps a thick ledger with one corner scorched black; a short knife stays sheathed at her belt. Her face is calm and tired. Smoke and lamp flares drift large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第2192行那一条）：香球离了薇丝佩的手，烟贴着地板往回退；阿卡夏整个人化进影子里，回廊上一排灯的影子全离了墙，一道一道缠上薇丝佩的手脚，把她钉在书房的门板上；账本是从炉口里偷回来的，烧了一个角；她的刀到底没有出鞘。沃尔夫拉姆靠着门框睡着。薇丝佩没有立绘。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·两边的名单
nodes.name: 一撮鱼干
who: the lanky young man with ink-blue hair
nodes.light: soft gold light of a late autumn afternoon down a narrow lane, warm on the top step, cool grey shadow below, a blue glint on short hair
nodes.camera: from a few steps down the stair, looking up at the two of them on the top step, the cat between, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late-autumn afternoon at the mouth of a narrow grey lane in the dungeon city, a short flight of worn stone steps going up between leaning houses, a bakery door standing open at the top with loaves on a board outside. On the top step sits the lanky young man with ink-blue hair, facing us: twenty-three, thin, very short ink-blue hair that shows blue only where the sun touches it, pale gold eyes narrowed against the light, a clean shirt too big for him. A yellow cat lies stretched across his knees. His left hand rests on the cat's back and his right hand is held out open, palm up. Beside him on the same step, in full profile facing left, the shadow-walking thief has just sat down: long black-violet hair, her hood pushed back for once, deep violet eyes; with her right hand she is setting a small pinch of dried fish in his open palm, and her left hand holds two iron keys on a ring against her knee. He is not smiling yet, and neither is she, but the cat has already lifted its head toward the fish. At the foot of the steps, small, a halfling cook with a pot on his back has crouched down to look up at them, and a party of adventurers waits behind him with sacks of bread. Flour dust and falling leaves drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束末一拍（源稿第2243行）：坠叶月下旬末，灰巷口，叶森坐在台阶最上一级，黄猫趴在他腿上，他说你迟到了两年；她在他旁边坐下，把一小撮鱼干放在他手心里；来面包房装干粮的一支队里，掌锅的半身人蹲下来问他不吃什么。两把钥匙照第2240行。

nodes.name: 咂舌问路
who: the lanky guide with ink-blue hair
the small cook with three pots
nodes.light: a darkness that swallows light: lantern flames are small hard yellow beads that light nothing, the figures only dim grey outlines, thin pale rings of sound drawing the walls ahead
nodes.camera: close beside the guide's tilted head, looking along the spreading rings down the passage, the roped file behind him, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in a passage through walls of fused bone, in a darkness that swallows light. Twelve people walk in single file, tied waist to waist on one rope. Several carry lanterns and every lantern is burning, yet each flame is only a small hard bead of yellow that lights nothing at all: no glow on a hand, no shine on a face. The people show only as dim grey outlines, as if felt rather than seen. At the head of the line, in full profile facing right, walks the lanky guide with ink-blue hair, twenty-three, thin, his eyes shut and his head tilted, his mouth just open after a click of the tongue. From his mouth thin pale rings spread out through the dark like ripples on water, and where the rings touch the walls they draw the passage ahead in faint lines: a bend, a low arch, and beyond it the curve of something enormous and ridged, with no face, that fills the passage from side to side like a wall. His right hand trails along the bone wall and his left hand holds the rope behind him. Third in the line, small as a child, comes the small cook with three pots, a halfling woman with honey-caramel curls and a berry-red hairpin, three iron pots of different sizes strapped on her back: her right hand is on the rope, and her left hand is lifted to feel the heat of a lantern flame against her palm. Behind her the grizzled captain, a man of fifty-two with short grizzled hair, grips the rope with both hands, his face turned toward the guide. Grey dust that does not shine drifts large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第六、七拍（源稿第2480、2481行）：走进暗窦，灯还亮着，光没了，火苗的热扑在脸上，眼前黑得像闭着眼；十二个人拿绳子拴成一串，叶森咂一下舌头认路；前头那面墙在吸气，是一个比升降井还粗的东西，一节一节。咂舌的回声画成一圈一圈淡的纹，是我补的看得见的样子。派派的三口锅照第2476行。

nodes.name: 琥珀锅
who: the small cook with three pots
nodes.light: no light from the fire at all, only a faint amber glow from the jelly inside the pot on a ring of faces, black all round
nodes.camera: at the level of the pot's rim, close, the cook tasting on the far side, the ring of bowls round it, the sleeping flank filling the opening behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a small dead-end cavity in walls of fused bone, in a darkness that swallows light. Twelve people sit shoulder to shoulder in a ring round one iron pot. Under the pot a fire of grey shell burns fiercely, heat pouring off it, yet it shows only as a dull red bead and lights nothing. The one thing with colour is what is in the pot: a thick amber jelly, glowing faintly like honey held up to a window, and that amber is the only light on the faces round it. On the far side of the pot, facing us, sits the small cook with three pots, a halfling woman with honey-caramel curls and a berry-red hairpin, her cheeks rosy even here: her right hand holds a long wooden spoon to her own lips, tasting first, and her left hand is raised flat toward the others, telling them to wait. On the left, in full profile facing right, the bone-white appraiser, a pale woman with long bone-white hair and a small patch of bare bone at one temple, holds a flake of black dregs between two fingers of her right hand and grips the cook's sleeve with her left. On the right, in full profile facing left, the lamp-priestess, a night-wing demon-kin woman with dark wings folded at her back, presses both hands on the bandaged leg of a big man who lies beside her under his own shield. Round the ring the others hold out tin bowls and wait. Behind them the mouth of the cavity is filled completely by the ridged flank of something enormous, asleep, with no face; one plate of its shell, the size of a pot lid, is just dropping off it. Flecks of ash and steam drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第二到四拍（源稿第2487到2489行）：它身上的硬壳一片一片往下掉，有锅盖那么大；老脾气底下烧的是硬壳外头那一层，烧得烫，一点光也没有；壳里琥珀色的冻刮进锅，格丝说壳底的黑渣三成是井里的东西；派派说我先尝。玛农按着伤口照第2486行。琥珀色的冻微微发亮是我补的，不然这一幅什么也看不见。

nodes.name: 吐回去
who: the small cook who has put down her pot
nodes.light: a burst of gold-red light exploding at the mouth of the cavern after seven days of total darkness, lighting twelve faces from the front, black rock behind
nodes.camera: from beside the beast's maw looking back at the cook and the shield wall, the blast of light between, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground at the mouth of a great lightless cavern, a place that has been in total darkness for seven days. On the right, filling the cavern mouth, is the long body of a huge soft-shelled beast that feeds on light, freshly moulted, its maw a man and a half high and turned toward us, as in the last attached picture. On the left a wall of scorched iron shields stands across the passage with ten fighters crouched behind it. Three steps in front of the shields, alone, stands the small cook who has put down her pot: a very small woman facing right in full profile, feet planted, head thrown back, both fists clenched at her sides; a big black iron cooking pot sits on the ground behind her. From her wide-open mouth a roaring stream of gold-red light and fire is pouring back at the beast, and where it strikes the beast's maw it bursts into a great flower of light that floods the whole cavern; the beast's soft new shell is splitting in several places and it is recoiling. Close behind the cook, in full profile facing right, the lamp-priestess has both arms wrapped round her from the back, her cheek pressed between the cook's shoulder blades, her lips moving in prayer, her eyes shut. Beside them a woman kneels with two fingers on the cook's wrist, counting. For the first time the faces behind the shields can be seen, wide-eyed. Sparks and flakes of shed shell fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第三、四拍（源稿第2461行那一条）：派派放下老脾气，往盾前头走了三步，张开嘴，那一口进了她的肚子；玛农从背后抱住她贴着背念祷词，格丝攥着她的手腕数；她打了个嗝，冲着它把那一口吐了回去，光在腔口炸开，整段暗窦七年里头一回亮了。饮光者用史诗战那一套当设计参考。

nodes.name: 头一杯
who: the lanky guide with ink-blue hair
nodes.light: warm lantern light under a wine shed, real light again after the dark, gold on faces and tin cups, the pale mouth of a bone valley behind
nodes.camera: from behind the plank counter, over the keeper's pouring hand, at the two of them arriving, the tired file of ten behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an underground camp at the mouth of a valley whose walls are fused bone, a row of lanterns on poles burning with honest warm light, a wine shed of planks with casks under it. Twelve filthy, thin people are coming into the camp out of the dark of the valley, and the first of them has reached the shed. He is the lanky guide with ink-blue hair, twenty-three, facing us, bent forward under a load: on his back he carries the small cook, a halfling woman with honey-caramel curls and a berry-red hairpin, wrapped in a blanket, pale and feverish, her chin on his shoulder. Both his hands are hooked under her knees. Her left arm is round his neck, and her right hand has come out of the blanket to take a tin cup that is being held out to her. The cup is held by an old bull-horned camp keeper behind the plank counter, seen directly from behind, a jug in his other hand, still tilted from pouring. She has taken one sip and is pulling a face at it, one eye shut. Behind the two of them, small, ten more people limp in, two of them on crutches, three iron pots swinging from a carrying pole between two shield-bearers, a grizzled captain counting heads at the rear. On a post beside the shed stands one earlier cup, left untouched. Lantern moths and dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第2505行）：往上走的路上派派病了七天，叶森背着她走了三层；到骨谷口的营，守营的人把头一杯倒给她，她喝了一口，说太淡了。十二个下去十二个上来照第2507行。桩头上那一只没喝的杯子照一幕第2478行。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·没有门框的门
nodes.name: 傍晚的灯
who: the locksmith's daughter with the key
nodes.light: a cold dark street at night, and through the opening door a sudden warm evening lamplight that belongs to another hour, gold on her face and hands
nodes.camera: From the lane at shoulder height, square to the door edge, so the door edge runs down the middle of the picture: the dark lane and her on the left, the lit room on the right
nodes.text: Scene: deep night in a narrow lane of old houses in the dungeon city, every window dark, signs of locksmiths and hinge-makers hanging still. The picture is split by the edge of one house door: on the left half is the dark lane outside, on the right half is the room inside, seen through the door as it swings inward. On the doorstep, on the dark left half, stands the locksmith's daughter with the key, in three-quarter view facing right toward the room: a sturdy young woman of twenty-three with pale apricot hair in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head, honey-coloured eyes, a plain wool coat. Her right hand is still on a brass key in the lock, a key with five teeth, a small chip out of its bow and a knotted cord hanging from it; her left hand is flat on the door, which has just swung inward a hand's width. And the room she is looking into, which was black a moment ago, is full of warm evening lamplight for this one instant: a lamp burning on a table laid for two, a man's coat on a hook, a chair pushed back, and nobody there. The light falls gold on her face. Her lips are parted and her eyes are wide with astonishment and longing, her brows lifted, not frowning; she has heard half a sentence. The lamp, the table, the coat and the chair are all on the right, inside the room, and none of them is in the lane; behind her on the left the lane is dark and empty, and the night sky is black above the roofs. Dust motes in the sudden lamplight hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第四拍（源稿第2741行）：当夜她拿它开自家的门，提也转，不提也转；门开的那一下，黑着的屋里亮了一瞬傍晚的灯，乔纳森的嗓子在里头说了半句门没锁，灯就灭了。钥匙的样子照第2738行。屋里没有人。 11-25 第四手：头一稿镜头从屋里往外看，桌子衣架却画在她身后的巷子里、看不出哪是屋里；她一脸凶相。改成门框把画面分左右、左边黑巷她站门口、右边屋里亮灯，神情写惊。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·没有门框的门
nodes.name: 千门一缝
who: the big man with half an oak door
the locksmith's daughter with the key
nodes.light: an amber-violet dusk that never moves, a lamp in every window, one white candle making a clear dome of light over four people, thin black lines of opening doors down the street
nodes.camera: low in the middle of the street behind the candle, the big man and the girl in front, the doors opening away on both sides to the vanishing point, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a walled city deep in the labyrinth where it is always dusk: an amber-violet evening sky that never changes, tall narrow houses with a lamp in every window and nobody behind any of them, every door locked, a key hanging on a nail beside each. At this instant every key in the street has swung on its nail to point at its door, and every door, hundreds down this street and thousands beyond, has opened by one finger's width, a thin line of dark in each. In the middle of the street the big man with half an oak door, a huge half-orc with iron-rust red hair shaved at the sides and braided in a short plait on top, half an oak door strapped to his back as a shield, has walked three steps toward one of the cracks, in full profile facing right, his right hand lifted toward it, his left hanging, his eyes vague. The locksmith's daughter with the key, a sturdy young woman with pale apricot hair in a coiled braid, has run headlong into him, also in full profile facing right: her head is butted against his waist, both her arms are locked round his belt, and her heels are skidding on the cobbles. Behind them, facing us, a tiefling healer in a white smock, with two small horns, holds one white candle high in her right hand, her left hand cupped round the flame, and its light falls in a clear dome over the four of them; outside the dome the air ripples. At the left, in full profile facing left, the grey-haired file-smith, long pale grey hair tucked behind one ear, has his ear close to a door and his left hand raised with three fingers up, his right hand holding a small file. Flakes of old paint and dusk light drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五、六拍（源稿第2752、2753行）：走到城当中，全城的钥匙一齐从钉子上转向门板，几千扇门同一刻开了一条缝，每条缝里有一个声音；诺维安一扇一扇报过去，叫卓根的那一扇没有芯；莎伦数着卓根的步子追上去，一头撞在他腰上，琪娅的烛光罩住四个人。门缝里不画人、不画脸。琪娅没进 who，照白烛提夫林写的。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·没有门框的门
nodes.name: 提钥
who: the locksmith's daughter with the key
the big man with half an oak door
nodes.light: cold grey light of a city inside a cavern, a single bright point where the key enters the lock, warm candle glow at the lower left
nodes.camera: at street level beside the man lying on the paving, looking up the whole height of the door-giant, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a street in a silent stone city deep underground, half its houses knocked flat.
