Standing in the street is a giant four storeys tall built entirely of house doors torn from their hinges and stacked together, with thousands of keys hanging in bunches at its waist; where its face should be there is only one blank door panel. In the middle of its chest is a single brass keyhole. It has stopped dead in mid-stride. High on its chest clings the locksmith's daughter with the key, in full profile facing right: her left hand grips the edge of a door plank, her right hand has pushed a key into the keyhole and is lifting it upward, her jaw set, her feet braced on a ledge of planks. Below her, at the giant's feet, the big man with half an oak door stands facing us, having just boosted her up from his shoulders: his knees are bent, and both his hands swing one half of a split oak door back over his head for a blow. In the left foreground, large and partly cut off, the file-smith with ruined hands lies on his side on the paving, facing us, his right ear pressed to the stone; both his hands are wrapped in thick stained bandages and held against his chest, his eyes shut, his mouth open, calling out. Beside him a small woman holds up a lit candle. Every key on the giant hangs perfectly still. Splinters and dust hang large and blurred in the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕末一拍（源稿第2724行那一条）：莎伦攥着哥哥那一把，踩着卓根的肩膀跳上它的胸口，钥匙插进去，往上提一下，卡住了，它整个身子停在半步上，几千把钥匙一齐哑了，卓根手里那半扇门从它头顶拍下来。诺维安两只手废着，侧躺在石板上耳朵贴着地报位。门房的脸会换，这里画成一块空门板，不画脸。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·没有门框的门
nodes.name: 掌心牙印
nodes.light: one warm lamp under a canvas canopy over the cot, soft gold on hands and faces, the rest of the ward in blue night shadow
nodes.camera: at the height of the board across his knees, close on the two hands and the needle, his face and hers above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a ward of the guild's infirmary, rows of cots under small canvas canopies, a lamp hung in each. On one cot sits the grey-haired file-smith, facing us, a thin man of twenty-six with long pale grey hair the colour of iron filings tucked behind one ear with a twist of copper wire, pale and steady. A board lies across his knees and both his hands rest on it. The left is already bound to splints. The right lies open, palm up: three of its fingers are splinted too, and printed round the palm is a ring of fine tooth marks, like the bite of something with a great many small teeth. Perched on a tall stool beside the cot, in full profile facing right, is the copper-curled halfling healer, a round-faced woman of fifty-six with red cheeks and copper-red curls tied back with a strip of white cloth: with her right hand she draws a curved needle and a thread through the edge of his palm, and with her left hand she steadies his wrist; her head is turned up to watch his face, and her mouth is open, asking a question. He is almost smiling. On the table by the cot lies a torn leather glove, bitten through, with a few slivers of bright brass beside it. At the foot of the cot, small, a sturdy young woman with a coiled apricot braid has fallen asleep sitting on the floor against a huge half-orc, a brass key on a cord wound round her fist. Lamp motes and lint drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第2768行）：医疗院里篷灯家的白烛茹比·篷灯缝了他一夜，缝一针问一句疼不疼；断了六根指头，掌心一圈细牙印。咬穿的手套和碎铜照第2770行。伤只画夹板和牙印，不画血。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第七次楼层主讨伐
nodes.name: 二十三枚
nodes.light: clear daylight from tall windows across a chart table, warm brown shadow among the shelves, a pale line of chalk glowing on the floorboards
nodes.camera: low on the floor beside the chalk line, looking up at the inner face of the tall shield and the three people round it, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day in the map room of a great guild hall, charts pinned on every wall. On the long table lies a big plan of a round hall drawn from above. Leaning upright against the table stands a tower shield as tall as a man, turned so that its inner face is toward us: scratched into the inside, set out in the outline of one human body, are twenty-three small groups of fine marks, three at the left shoulder, seven across the chest, the rest down the arms and legs. Beside the shield, facing us, stands the ink-scaled dragonborn captain, a broad heavy man with ink-dark scales along his jaw and brow: his right hand rests on the rim of the shield and his left hand holds out a small ink pad. In front of him, in full profile facing right, the night-wing map-flier, a small lean demon-kin woman with short pale purple hair and orange-red eyes; her wings, half folded, are feathered and mist-white, pure white along their length with a band of ink-black only at the very tips, and a crooked line of white stitches runs across the left wing; her wings are not grey, not purple and not dark, presses a small brass travel seal down on a sheet on the table with her right hand, her left hand flat beside it; her eyes are on the sheet, and she does not look at the mark in the middle of the shield's chest. On the left, kneeling on the floor in full profile facing right, the pale-gold-haired young surveyor, twenty-three, pale gold hair to the shoulders that will not lie flat, tied loosely with a length of chalk line, holds a chalk-line box in her left hand and the end of its string pinned under her right thumb; the string has just been snapped, and a straight pale line glows on the floorboards and runs out through the door. In the doorway, small, a halfling healer holds a brass carriage lamp blackened on one side. Chalk dust drifts large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第二到四拍（源稿第3010到3012行）：肯特的塔盾内面刻着二十三个外号，照一个人的身子排，左肩三个，胸口七个；季娜来按印，盾上胸口正中那个外号是她哥哥的，她没看盾；蕾雅取出父亲的粉线盒，两头按上旅印一弹，地上透出一道线。茹比拎着熏黑了一边的铜车灯照第3011行。外号写成认不出的细痕。 11-25 第四手：头一稿济娜的翅膀画成了灰紫色、没有黑翼尖和缝线（立绘是雾白、尖上一道墨黑、左翼一道缝线），写明重画。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第七次楼层主讨伐
nodes.name: 一个口子
nodes.light: a wall of still white like fog glowing coldly in front, one small warm brass lamp on a pole behind, grey stone and grey sky
nodes.camera: low among the seated fighters, looking up past them at the one standing figure and the white wall, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep in the labyrinth, on a floor of bare grey stone under a grey sky, before the mouth of a vast round hall. Across the mouth hangs a wall of stilled white, smooth as fog, and nothing can be seen through it. On the ground in front of it lies one black helmet with a small number of marks chased on its rim. Thirty-four armed people sit on the stone in loose rows facing the white, drinking the last of their water, flasks tipped up, nobody speaking. Among them, in full profile facing right, sits the ink-scaled dragonborn captain, broad and heavy, ink-dark scales along his jaw, a tower shield as tall as a man laid across his knees with both his hands on it, his head bowed as if listening. Near him, facing us, the copper-curled halfling healer, round-faced, copper-red curls tied back with a strip of white cloth, holds a length of broken banner pole upright with both hands, and from its top hangs a brass carriage lamp blackened on one side, lit. Only one person is standing. In the middle, seen directly from behind, the pale-gold-haired young surveyor, twenty-three, pale gold hair tied loosely with a length of chalk line, a sketchbook in her left hand, faces the white with her right arm raised and one finger held up. Faint rings spread on the surface of the white, as if something on the far side were beating slowly on a shield. Grey dust and threads of white drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕末几拍和幕终前（源稿第3022到3024行）：地上一顶黑耀的盔，盔沿錾着十九；茹比拔起一截断旗杆扛着，说这一根挂灯正好；厅口横着一道静下来的乱潮，白得像雾，白的那一边一下一下敲盾；肯特叫大家坐下把水喝完；蕾雅喝完站起来数口子，进去剩一个，一个也是一个。白那一边的东西不画。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第七次楼层主讨伐
nodes.name: 晾绳巷
who: the woman who runs the retreat
nodes.light: a tall slit of pale blue dawn light standing open in the air on the left, warm and soft, inside a hall of black stone lit by one lantern on a flagpole; the thing by the far wall is a dark bronze shape
nodes.camera: low among the wounded on the floor, looking toward the open slit of light with her beside it, the guardian far behind, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a hall of black stone so tall its roof cannot be seen, deep underground; the floor is torn by long furrows and a crack runs its whole length. Far back by the west wall, under a breach high in the stone, stands the guardian of this floor as in the last attached picture: a giant with deep bronze skin, horns bent forward, eyes closed, a tower shield planted in front of him, rows of small dull brass seals studding his body. He is not moving. In the foreground a lantern hangs on a flagpole, and a small woman has collapsed asleep beneath it among a dozen wounded fighters lying on cloaks. Beside the lantern a door has opened in the empty air: a tall slit of pale blue light, and through it, clear and small, a narrow town lane at dawn with washing lines strung from wall to wall and bedsheets lifting in a breeze. At the slit, in full profile facing left, stands the woman who runs the retreat, the only one on her feet: her right hand presses a brass seal on a cord against the lower edge of the light, her left hand is on the back of the shield captain, pushing him through. The shield captain, in full profile facing left, is half across the threshold, his right shoulder bound in bloody bandage, his shield hanging from his left arm, his face turned down. Her own face is wet and blank, like someone forgetting something while she watches. Motes of blue light and stone dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六、七拍（源稿第2994行那一条）：蕾雅一个人站着，把旅印按在缝底下，缝裂成一道门，门那一边是晾绳巷；门开着要交东西，交的是她记得的家；肯特是最后一个，她把他推了过去。茹比唱到自己倒在灯下。殿后者站在裂口正下方不追人，用史诗战那一套当设计参考。肯特右肩那一枪写成缠着带血的绷带。

nodes.line: 深井的年月·第七次楼层主讨伐
nodes.name: 四十一张
who: the old baker with the blue headcloth
nodes.light: low gold sun of a late autumn morning down a stepped lane, washing bright on the lines overhead, a warm glow from a bakery door
nodes.camera: from the step just below her, close on the open sketchbook and her pencil, the lane and the baker above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late-autumn morning in a narrow stepped lane of the dungeon city: thirty-odd worn stone steps climbing between old houses, washing lines strung across overhead with sheets on them, and halfway up a small bakery with its door open and its lamp lit. On a step below the bakery sits the pale-gold-haired young surveyor, facing us, twenty-three, pale gold hair to the shoulders that will not lie flat, tied loosely with a length of chalk line, a blanket round her shoulders. A sketchbook lies open on her knees. The left-hand page is a finished drawing of this very lane, the steps, the lines, the lit bakery door. On the right-hand page she is drawing the same lane again from where she sits: her right hand holds the pencil at the bottom of the page, just lifting from a short line of fine marks written under the picture, and her left hand keeps the book flat. She is looking up from the page at the lane as if she had never seen it before, careful and a little lost. In the bakery doorway behind her, in full profile facing left, stands the old baker with the blue headcloth, white hair wrapped in a blue cloth, flour on both forearms, a warm loaf held in both hands against her apron, watching the girl and not coming nearer. Further up, small, a neighbour hangs out a sheet. Flour dust and the steam of new bread drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束末一拍（源稿第3044行）：入冬以前蕾雅翻开速写册，前四十张她认得是自己的笔，认不出是哪里；她照着第四十张画了第四十一张，在底下写了一行，这是我家。晾绳巷、三十几级台阶、天不亮就亮灯的面包房照第3018行，穆丽尔照第3039行。底下那一行写成认不出的细痕。

nodes.name: 蓝旗升起
who: the ship's master with the long halberd
nodes.light: a clear gold sunrise over silver water, white sails catching the first light, long blue shadows across the deck
nodes.camera: low on the deck behind the wheel, the singer at the bow ahead, the smooth lane of water and the fleet beyond, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise over a wide silver bay ringed by a white harbour city and its sea wall. A blue flag is running up the mast of a great three-decked warship with crystal cannon along its side, and thirty-one sails are standing out through the harbour mouth: the tall warship on the outside, four slim fast ships, and twenty-six small fishing boats in the middle. The foreground is the deck of the leading fast ship, heading right. At the bow, in full profile facing right, stands the singer with gill slits, a siren with long pale coral hair pinned up with a fishbone pin and gill slits on the side of her neck: both her hands rest on the bow rail, her head is lifted and her mouth is open in song, and ahead of the bow the swell is lying down flat, a long smooth lane of water opening across the bay as far as her voice reaches. At the wheel amidships, facing us, stands the ship's master with the long halberd, thirty-seven, in a weathered sea coat: his right hand is on the wheel, and his left hand holds a tall halberd upright with its butt on the deck. His head is turned toward the big warship, where, small on its quarterdeck, a white-haired old captain lifts his hat to him. On the roof of a sail loft on the quay, small, a man waves both arms. Gulls and blown spray drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第3346行）：九日天亮蓝旗升起，三十一面帆出了白银海湾；归针船头的赛壬罗瑟琳·九船唱起压浪的老调，提姆洛站在帆房顶上冲船队喊。一大四小护二十六条渔船照第3343行，汉弗莱在外头照第3345行。压浪画成船头前一道平下去的水路。

nodes.name: 不许回头
who: the ship's master with the long halberd
the fisher girl with the brass whistle
nodes.light: a grey dawn at sea, a sheet of white cannon fire and a wild searchlight beam behind, cold green-grey water, hard spray
nodes.camera: low on the stern deck in front of the wheel, his face close, the sinking warship and the rising back of the thing behind his shoulder, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a grey dawn on the open sea. Filling the background, a great three-decked warship is going down by the stern. Under it the sea has heaved up into the back of a creature longer than the ship itself, a ridge of bone spines like a row of snapped masts, and the ship's stern is dragged under while its bow lifts; a whole side of crystal cannon is firing straight down into the water in one sheet of white, and a searchlight beam swings across the sky. From the warship's masthead a string of signal flags stands out stiff in the wind. Along the whole horizon behind stand rows of tall black fins. In the foreground is the stern deck of a slim fast ship racing toward us, away from all of it. At the wheel, facing us, stands the ship's master with the long halberd, thirty-seven, in a soaked sea coat, both hands locked on the spokes of the wheel, his jaw clenched and his eyes straight ahead at us; a long halberd is lashed upright beside him. He does not look back. Beside him at the rail, in full profile facing left and looking back at the warship, the fisher girl with the brass whistle, a scale-folk woman of twenty-seven with a patch of dulled scales on the side of her neck, grips the stern rail with her left hand and presses a brass whistle to her chest with her right; her mouth is open. Behind her a sailor writes in a small book braced on his knee. Around them, small, fishing boats run under full sail. Spray and scraps of torn net fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五、六拍（源稿第3354、3355行）：高帆底下的海鼓了起来，一条比高帆还长的背拱出水面，骨刺一排像折断的桅杆，它咬住高帆的船尾往下拖；高帆的桅顶升起旗语，不许回头，带船回港；亚历山大没有回头，叫人把高帆的方位记进方位簿。黑鳍从天边排到天边照第3352行。折桅者只画拱出水面的背。

nodes.name: 戟入脊线
who: the ship's master with the long halberd
the fisher girl with the brass whistle
nodes.light: black storm night split by white lightning, a pale line of foam glowing along the ridge of the tide under the bow, the wall of sea behind lit from inside by the lightning
nodes.camera: on the foredeck at the height of his hands on the halberd shaft, the wall of sea towering behind the ships, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a night of storm far out at sea. Thirteen vessels, twelve small fishing boats and one armed ship, are lashed together in a raft with heavy black cables, riding a narrow line of white water that runs through black swells like a spine. Behind them the whole sea has stood up into a wall taller than a lighthouse, and the wall is travelling away with the ships carried on its front slope; inside the wall, caught and dragged along, is the dark shape of a huge spined sea beast and a ring of black fins, and the thunderclouds above have bent to follow it. In the bow of the armed ship, in the middle of the picture, the ship's master with the long halberd stands in full profile facing right, legs braced: both hands grip a long ship's halberd driven straight down over the bow into the white line of water, and his right palm has split open, blood running down the shaft over his fingers; his teeth are clenched and he keeps pressing down. At the very stem beside him, facing us, the singer with gill slits leans out over the water with her mouth open in song, her left hand on the rail, her right hand stretched toward the sea, and the waves under her hand are lower than the rest. On the next boat, small, facing us, the fisher girl with the brass whistle blows three notes with the whistle in her right hand, her left hand on the tiller. One sail on the armed ship is drawn tight as a drum. Spray, rain and flakes of foam fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第3326行那一条）：亚历山大摘下船头的长戟，朝脚底下的脊线扎了下去，一整圈潮的分量从戟杆涌进他的右掌，掌心裂开，血顺着杆往下流，他照旧压着，罗瑟琳在船头唱给海听；十三条船身后的海立了起来，立成一道比信号塔还高的墙，墙反着走，折桅者连同围圈的黑鳍叫墙卷了进去；提娜吹母亲的铜哨。两拍并成一个场面。

nodes.name: 铜哨挂钉
who: the fisher girl with the brass whistle
nodes.light: a pale overcast autumn afternoon on a breakwater, flat silver light off the water, a small warm glint on brass
nodes.camera: close along the board of names at the height of the nail, her hand and the whistle near the centre, the grey bay behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a pale overcast autumn afternoon on a long stone breakwater at the mouth of a silver bay, fishing boats moored inside it, fewer than there were. Fixed to the sea wall is a long weathered board, and on it hang seventy-one small wooden slats on nails, each scratched with a few fine unreadable marks, all stirring in the wind. In front of the first nail, in full profile facing right, stands the fisher girl with the brass whistle, a scale-folk woman of twenty-seven with fine scales along the side of her neck, in a patched oilskin: with her right hand she is hanging a brass whistle by its cord on that first nail, on top of the slat that is already there, and her left hand is closed tight at her side. Her head is bowed. Beside her, facing us with his back to the sea, stands the ship's master, thirty-seven, in a plain dark coat with no weapon: his right hand is wrapped in a clean bandage across the palm and hangs at his side, and his left hand rests on the top of the board. He is looking at her and his mouth is shut. Behind them the bay lies flat and empty out to the harbour mouth, where one small ship stands on watch. On the quay, small, a man is hauling a sail up a mast to look it over. Gulls' feathers and salt spray drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三拍（源稿第3371、3372行）：七十一个名字在防波堤上挂了一个月，头一个是汉弗莱·克罗夫特；提娜把母亲的铜哨挂在名单的钉子上，跟亚历山大说那一网是她要撒的；他右手缝了一夜，掌心留下一道横白，一冬没碰舵；提姆洛来验归针那面帆。口子哨照第3373行。名字写成认不出的细痕。

nodes.name: 影子抱册
nodes.light: orange fire along one eave of the account house, torches streaming across a dark square, market lanterns swinging, deep blue night above the hills
nodes.camera: from inside the account house window beside her stool, looking out past her profile at the men running after the shadow on the far wall, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a hill market of timber stalls and lanterns round a wide square; the account house at its edge is on fire along one eave. Thirty-odd armed men in salt-white tabards are charging away from the building across the square, the two in front in heavier gear, torches streaming, all of them chasing something that runs along the lit wall of the house opposite: a shadow with no body to cast it, the shadow of a fox-tailed woman hugging the shadow of a book, leaping from wall to wall just ahead of the torches. Behind their backs, in the open window of the burning account house, the fox-eared market girl sits perfectly still on a high clerk's stool, in full profile facing left: a woman of thirty-two with pricked fox ears and one bushy tail curled round the legs of the stool, a small bell tied at the root of the tail. She casts no shadow at all. Her right arm holds a thick ledger closed against her chest, and her left hand is wrapped round the little bell so that it cannot ring. Her head is tilted, watching them go. Under the window, small, an old halfling woman with her eyes closed drags an iron chest of paper slips away from the fire, and a broad man crawls out from under a cart with a wheel axle in his fist. Sparks and burning scraps of paper fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍（源稿第3610行）：三日夜里账房起了火，萨尔茨曼家押盐车的人翻过坡来，三十几个，领头的两个是英雄，冲的是那本册子；琥珀把铃声留在高凳上，一条尾巴的影子抱着一本册子的影子往窗外跑，那伙人追着影子去了。丝缇的铁箱和票照第3607行，迈洛照第3608行。她自己不带影子是我补的看得见的样子。

nodes.name: 买一天
nodes.light: grey first light through the windows of a post-house hall, one candle on the long table, a small hard gold glint on the coin
nodes.camera: at table height, close on the coin and her fingertip, the nine seated lords along the table beyond, the gallery above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: before dawn in the hall of a post-house where nine roads meet: a long table, nine heads of merchant families seated along it, each with a seal ring, and through the windows a yard packed with armed men and horses. In the exact middle of the table lies one old gold coin stamped with a bird, and nothing else. Standing at the near side of the table, in full profile facing right, is the fox-eared market girl, thirty-two, fox ears upright, one bushy tail with a small bell at its root, in her best dark market coat: the forefinger of her right hand is still on the coin where she has set it down, and her left hand is behind her back, steady. Facing her across the table, in full profile facing left, at the middle of the nine, sits the salt lord, a man with silver-white curly hair cropped very short and water-blue eyes, heavy rings on both hands: his right hand has started toward the coin to push it back and has stopped in the air, his left hand flat on a folded deed; the other eight lords are all looking at his hand. Behind her shoulder, facing us, the fox-eared runner, eighteen, lean, his fox ears flat, holds his own tail in his right fist to keep its bell quiet, his left hand on the door. On the gallery above the table stand five stewards in the liveries of old noble houses, and behind them a tall figure in a grey cloak whose face is lost in its hood, one lock of silver-blue hair showing. Candle smoke and dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第一到三拍（源稿第3616到3618行）：天不亮，琥珀带尼诺走进九岔驿，九家的家主在长桌边坐着，院里站满了要进市集的人马；她把金鸢币放在桌当中，这一枚买你们一天；钱摆上桌没人推回去买卖就立着；谁单碰铃尾一枚钱他的份子归另外八家，所以奥伊根的手停在半路。驿楼上五家旧贵族的管家和披灰斗篷的高个子照第3618行，不画脸。

nodes.name: 九尾九口
nodes.light: nine walls of gold-orange fox fire ringing the square like the rim of a glowing bowl, a small ring of nine pale blue-white flames hanging high above, white salt glittering cold wherever the fire has not reached
nodes.camera: low on the cobbles of the square behind the salt lord's knee, looking up at her and her nine tails fanned across the frame, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dead of night in the open market square of a town on the hills, a square with nine roads leading into it; honey wells, stalls and heaps of paper wage tickets. Walls and pillars of white salt as tall as a man have grown up out of the ground on every side and are pushing in along the nine roads. In the middle of the square stands the fox-eared market girl, facing us: fox ears, and behind her nine long tails of golden orange spread from one root like a fan, each tail stretched out to a different road mouth, and at the tip of each a wall of gold-orange fire stands across that road, so that the square is ringed by nine curtains of flame. High above the square hangs a small ring of nine separate pale blue-white flames, set in a circle like candles on a wheel, with dark sky showing through the middle of the ring. Her right hand has just flicked a single small bronze-gold coin, which spins in the air toward the ground; her left hand rests on her hip, a small bell at her belt; she is not smiling. In the right foreground, large and partly cut off, the salt lord kneels in full profile facing left beside a stone honey well: a spear of white salt is crumbling to water in his right hand, his left hand is on the ground, and the crust of salt on his coat is burning off him layer by layer in cold fire. Behind a broken cart axle at a road mouth, small, a halfling man shields a tiny child, both unhurt, and a boy rings a hand bell. Sparks of fox fire and grains of salt drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六、七拍（源稿第3592行那一条）：九条金橙的尾巴从一处尾根分出去，一条守一个路口，九道狐火的墙把广场围成一只发亮的碗；琥珀把一枚便士弹到他脚前，九条尾巴的火一齐落在他身上，他身上的盐一层一层烧尽，人跪在了蜂蜜井边。原文广场上头九堆冷火聚成一轮幻月，这一本不画月，写成九朵分开的冷火排成一圈、当中透着夜空。尼诺摇铃、迈洛和三岁的崽子是远处小人，不受伤。

nodes.name: 九条尾巴
nodes.light: warm noon sun on a market square, gold on fur and on a row of small glowing paper slips, blue shade under the stall awnings
nodes.camera: low at the height of the sugar jar and the small child, looking up at her and the nine tails fanned behind her, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bright noon in a hill market, the square busy again, the account house with one scorched eave already being mended. At its door stands a table with a big glass sugar jar full to the brim. Behind the table, facing us, sits the fox-eared market girl, thirty-two, fox ears upright, and behind her, where there used to be one tail, nine bushy tails are spread like a fan, a small bell tied at the root of one of them. With her right hand she is counting three coins into the two cupped hands of a tiny fox-eared child of three who stands on tiptoe in front of the table, and with her left hand she holds up one finger, explaining that the third coin is the interest. The child is beaming. Along the wall beside the table waits a line of mercenaries with their swords sheathed, each holding a paper slip that glows faintly round its seal. At the end of the table, in full profile facing left, the fox-eared runner, eighteen, lean, a bell at the root of his tail, stacks paid slips into an iron chest with both hands, grinning at the child. At the far corner of the square, small, a broad man crouches under a cart fitting an axle, and beyond the roofs one long tear in the clouds over the southern hills is slowly closing. Petals and market dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三、六拍（源稿第3637、3638、3641行）：守过路障的佣兵拿着亮过的票来账房，琥珀照数垫了；糖罐满了，那个三岁的崽子拿到三枚，她说多的一枚是利钱；迈洛照旧在东南口修车轴；九条尾巴没有收回去。南坡上头云里那道口子到第三天才合上照第3639行。孩子只是领钱。
